queries.description: Answer a general question about how HAWAQM works — data success rate, device intervals, offline rules, site AQI calculation, monitored parameters, AQI categories. No database query needed.
patterns: what does data success rate mean
when is a device considered offline
when is a device considered inactive
when is a site shown as inactive
what aqi range is unhealthy for sensitive
what aqi range is very unhealthy
what is the minimum data success rate
can i view indoor and ambient

queries.description: Get current AQI for ALL sites — aggregated per site. Use ONLY when user asks for AQI across all sites with NO specific site name mentioned.
patterns: what is the aqi for all sites

queries.description: Get the latest live AQI or pollutant reading for a specific named site or station. ALWAYS use this when the user mentions a specific site or station name — including named schools like 'Al Saad Indian School', 'Al Bateen School' (a named school = a specific site). Takes priority over site_aqi_all and schools_latest_pollutant whenever a specific site name is present.
patterns: what is the current aqi at

queries.description: Get the latest reading of a specific pollutant (e.g. CO2, PM2.5, AQI) across ALL school sites (Public & Govt-School sector), optionally filtered by region. Use ONLY when user says 'schools' generically (e.g. 'all schools', 'schools in Al Ain') WITHOUT naming a specific school. If a specific school name is mentioned (e.g. 'Al Saad Indian School'), use site_aqi_single instead.
Get the latest readings for all parameters at a specific station (site), or all permitted stations if no station is specified. Use for site/station names, NOT device names.
patterns: what is the AQI at station
queries.sql: SELECT pr.CreatedTime, s.StationName, p.ParameterName, pr.Parametervalue, u.UnitName, pr.SubIndex, pr.Alarm FROM ParameterReadings pr JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pr.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pr.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pr.StationID = @stationId AND pr.Status = 1 AND pr.CreatedTime >= DATEADD(HOUR, -2, GETUTCDATE()) ORDER BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, pr.CreatedTime DESC

queries.description: Get the latest reading for a specific pollutant across all accessible stations
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, p.ParameterName, pr.Parametervalue, u.UnitName, pr.SubIndex, pr.CreatedTime FROM ParameterReadings pr JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pr.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pr.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pr.Status = 1 AND pr.CreatedTime >= DATEADD(HOUR, -1, GETUTCDATE()) ORDER BY pr.SubIndex DESC

queries.description: Show hourly average trend for a pollutant at a station over a date range
queries.sql: SELECT pa.Interval, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as MaxValue, MIN(pa.Parametervalue) as MinValue, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, s.StationName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY pa.Interval, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, s.StationName ORDER BY pa.Interval

queries.description: Show monthly average trend for a pollutant at a station
queries.sql: SELECT pam.Interval, AVG(pam.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pam.Parametervalue) as MaxValue, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, s.StationName FROM ParameterAveragesMonth pam JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pam.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pam.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pam.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pam.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pam.Status = 1 GROUP BY pam.Interval, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, s.StationName ORDER BY pam.Interval

queries.description: Compare a pollutant between two stations over a date range
queries.sql: SELECT pa.Interval, s.StationName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID IN (@stationId1, @stationId2) AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY pa.Interval, s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY pa.Interval, s.StationName

queries.description: Find the stations with the highest pollutant readings over a period
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 10 s.StationName, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as PeakValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY AvgValue DESC

queries.description: Find the stations with the lowest (best) pollutant readings over a period
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 10 s.StationName, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MIN(pa.Parametervalue) as MinValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY AvgValue ASC

queries.description: Calculate the average, min, and max of a pollutant at a station over a date range
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as Average, MIN(pa.Parametervalue) as Minimum, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as Maximum, COUNT(*) as ReadingCount FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName

queries.description: Count how many readings exceeded the MOCCAE standard threshold for a pollutant at a station
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, p.ParameterName, ev.ExcedenceValue, u.UnitName, COUNT(*) as ExceedanceCount, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as PeakValue FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID JOIN Parameters_Excedence_Values ev ON ev.Parameter = p.ParameterName WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Parametervalue > ev.ExcedenceValue AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, ev.ExcedenceValue, u.UnitName

queries.description: Count exceedances across all stations for a pollutant — ranked worst to best
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, p.ParameterName, ev.ExcedenceValue, u.UnitName, COUNT(*) as ExceedanceCount, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as PeakValue FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID JOIN Parameters_Excedence_Values ev ON ev.Parameter = p.ParameterName WHERE p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Parametervalue > ev.ExcedenceValue AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, ev.ExcedenceValue, u.UnitName ORDER BY ExceedanceCount DESC

queries.description: Rank all stations by average pollutant level
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as PeakValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY AvgValue DESC

queries.description: Hourly breakdown of a pollutant at a station on a specific date
queries.sql: SELECT DATEPART(HOUR, pa.Interval) as Hour, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as MaxValue, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND CAST(pa.Interval AS DATE) = @targetDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY DATEPART(HOUR, pa.Interval), p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY Hour

queries.description: Find which hours of the day have the highest pollution levels on average
queries.sql: SELECT DATEPART(HOUR, pa.Interval) as Hour, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, COUNT(*) as ReadingCount FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY DATEPART(HOUR, pa.Interval) ORDER BY AvgValue DESC

queries.description: Get all pollutant averages at a station for a date range — multi-pollutant overview
queries.sql: SELECT p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MIN(pa.Parametervalue) as MinValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as MaxValue FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY p.ParameterName

queries.description: Month-over-month comparison of a pollutant at a station
queries.sql: SELECT FORMAT(pam.Interval, 'yyyy-MM') as Month, AVG(pam.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pam.Parametervalue) as MaxValue, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAveragesMonth pam JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pam.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pam.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pam.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pam.Status = 1 GROUP BY FORMAT(pam.Interval, 'yyyy-MM'), p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY Month

queries.description: Worst pollutant readings across all stations in the past 7 days
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 20 s.StationName, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as PeakValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, GETUTCDATE()) AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY AvgValue DESC

queries.description: Device uptime/compliance rate for a station over a date range
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, d.DeviceName, COUNT(*) as ActiveDays, DATEDIFF(DAY, @startDate, @endDate) + 1 as TotalDays, CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / (DATEDIFF(DAY, @startDate, @endDate) + 1) * 100 as CompliancePct FROM DeviceCompliance dc JOIN DMN_Devices d ON dc.DeviceId = d.ID JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID WHERE d.StationID = @stationId AND dc.RecordedDate BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND dc.IsActive = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, d.DeviceName ORDER BY CompliancePct DESC

queries.description: List all stations in a specific sector with their current status
queries.sql: SELECT s.ID, s.StationName, s.OrganizationName, s.Location, sec.SectorName, sub.SectorName as SubSectorName, r.RegionName, CASE s.Status WHEN 1 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS Status FROM DMN_Stations s LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN SubSectors sub ON s.SubSectorID = sub.Id LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE sec.SectorName = @sectorName ORDER BY s.StationName

queries.description: Temperature and humidity trend over time (historical chart) — only use when user asks for trend, chart, graph, or history
queries.sql: SELECT pa.Interval, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName IN ('Temperature', 'Humidity') AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY pa.Interval, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY pa.Interval, p.ParameterName

queries.description: CO2 and TVOC trend over time (historical chart) at a station — only use when user asks for trend, chart, graph, or history
queries.sql: SELECT pa.Interval, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName IN ('CO2', 'TVOC') AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY pa.Interval, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY pa.Interval, p.ParameterName

queries.description: List all monitoring stations/sites the user is eligible to access — returns site names. Use for LIST questions only, NOT for count/how-many questions.
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, r.RegionName FROM DMN_Stations s LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE s.Status = 1 ORDER BY s.StationName

queries.description: Count the total number of registered sites/stations in HAWAQM. Admin role only. Use for HOW MANY / COUNT / TOTAL questions about sites.
patterns: how many sites are currently registered
how many sites are in hawaqm
how many sites does hawaqm have
how many sites do i have
how many sites can i access
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalSiteCount FROM DMN_Stations WHERE Status = 1

queries.description: Count the total number of registered devices in HAWAQM. Admin role only.
patterns: how many devices are currently registered
how many devices does hawaqm have
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalDeviceCount FROM DMN_Devices WHERE Status = 1 AND ISNULL(IsEnable, 1) = 1

queries.description: List all devices/sensors installed at a specific station or site by name — shows DeviceName for each device registered under that site.
patterns: what devices are in this site
queries.sql: SELECT d.DeviceName, s.StationName FROM DMN_Devices d JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID WHERE s.ID = (SELECT TOP 1 ID FROM DMN_Stations WHERE REPLACE(LOWER(StationName),' ','') LIKE '%' + @stationNameNormalized + '%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(StationName) = LOWER(@stationName) THEN 0 WHEN REPLACE(LOWER(StationName),' ','') = @stationNameNormalized THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, LEN(StationName) ASC) AND d.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsEnable, 1) = 1 ORDER BY d.DeviceName

queries.description: Count and list sites/stations in a specific region — Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, or Al Dhafra. Shows each site name and active/inactive status.
patterns: total sites in al ain region
how many sites in al ain
how many stations in al ain
number of sites in al ain
total sites in abu dhabi region
how many sites in abu dhabi
how many stations in abu dhabi
number of sites in abu dhabi
total sites in al dhafra region
how many sites in al dhafra
how many stations in al dhafra
number of sites in al dhafra
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, s.OrganizationName, r.RegionName, sec.SectorName, CASE s.Status WHEN 1 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS Status FROM DMN_Stations s JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id WHERE LOWER(r.RegionName) = LOWER(@regionName) ORDER BY s.Status DESC, s.StationName

queries.description: List sites/stations in a specific region — Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, or Al Dhafra. Use this when the user mentions a region name.
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, s.OrganizationName, sec.SectorName, sub.SectorName AS SubSectorName, r.RegionName, CASE s.Status WHEN 1 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS Status FROM DMN_Stations s LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN SubSectors sub ON s.SubSectorID = sub.Id LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE LOWER(r.RegionName) = LOWER(@regionName) ORDER BY s.StationName

queries.description: Get the latest reading of a specific pollutant (CO, NO2, SO2, CO2, PM2.5, AQI, etc.) across all sites in a specific sector (Commercial, Industrial, Residential, Public & Govt-School), optionally filtered by region. Use whenever the user asks for a parameter reading for a sector.
patterns: co reading for commercial sites in
no2 reading for commercial sites in
co reading for industrial sites in

queries.description: List sites in a specific named sector — Commercial, Public & Govt-School, Industrial, or Residential. Only use when the user names a specific sector.
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, s.OrganizationName, sec.SectorName, sub.SectorName AS SubSectorName, r.RegionName, CASE s.Status WHEN 1 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS Status FROM DMN_Stations s LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN SubSectors sub ON s.SubSectorID = sub.Id LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE LOWER(sec.SectorName) = LOWER(@sectorName) ORDER BY s.StationName

queries.description: Count of sites grouped by ALL sectors — use when user asks how many sites per sector, breakdown by sector, or sites in each sector (no specific sector named).
patterns: how many sites in each sector
how many sites are there in each sector
how many sites are in each sector
how many stations in each sector
number of sites in each sector
queries.sql: SELECT sec.SectorName, COUNT(*) AS TotalSites, SUM(CASE WHEN s.Status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ActiveSites FROM DMN_Stations s JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id GROUP BY sec.SectorName ORDER BY TotalSites DESC

queries.description: Count of sites grouped by ALL regions, and answers questions like 'what are the regions', 'how many regions'. Shows every region with total and active site counts.
patterns: how many sites in each region
queries.sql: SELECT r.RegionName, COUNT(*) AS TotalSites, SUM(CASE WHEN s.Status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ActiveSites FROM DMN_Stations s JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id GROUP BY r.RegionName ORDER BY TotalSites DESC

queries.description: Find the site with the lowest current AQI from live DMN_Parameters readings — returns site name, region, AQI value and timestamp.
patterns: which site has the lowest aqi today
which site has the lowest aqi
which site has lowest aqi today
which site has best air quality today
which location has the lowest aqi
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 1 s.StationName, r.RegionName, ROUND(p.ParameterValue, 0) AS MinAQI, p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime AS LastUpdated FROM DMN_Parameters p JOIN DMN_Devices d ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -30, GETDATE()) ORDER BY p.ParameterValue ASC

queries.description: Find the site with the highest current AQI from live DMN_Parameters readings — returns site name, region, AQI value and timestamp.
patterns: which site has the highest aqi today
which site has the highest aqi
which site has highest aqi today
which site has worst air quality today
which location has the highest aqi
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 1 s.StationName, r.RegionName, ROUND(p.ParameterValue, 0) AS MaxAQI, p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime AS LastUpdated FROM DMN_Parameters p JOIN DMN_Devices d ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -30, GETDATE()) ORDER BY p.ParameterValue DESC

queries.description: List all sites with their current AQI values ranked from lowest to highest. Use when user asks for AQI per site, site-wise AQI, or all sites AQI ranking.
patterns: current aqi values for all sites
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, r.RegionName, ROUND(p.ParameterValue, 0) AS AQI, p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime AS LastUpdated FROM DMN_Parameters p JOIN DMN_Devices d ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -30, GETDATE()) ORDER BY p.ParameterValue ASC

queries.description: Get the current average AQI from DB readings for one or all regions (Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Al Dhafra) — use only when historical/DB-based regional AQI is explicitly needed
patterns: aqi readings by region from db
queries.sql: SELECT r.RegionName, ROUND(AVG(CAST(pr.ParameterValue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS AvgAQI, MAX(pr.ParameterValue) AS MaxAQI, MIN(pr.ParameterValue) AS MinAQI, MAX(pr.CreatedTime) AS LastUpdated, COUNT(DISTINCT s.ID) AS SiteCount FROM ParameterReadings pr JOIN DMN_Parameters dp ON pr.ParameterID = dp.ID JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pr.StationID = s.ID JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE dp.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND pr.Status = 1 AND pr.CreatedTime >= DATEADD(HOUR, -2, GETUTCDATE()) GROUP BY r.RegionName ORDER BY r.RegionName

queries.description: Count how many devices are currently active versus total registered devices for the user's permitted sites. A device is active if its last ParameterReadingUpdateTime in DMN_Parameters is within 15 minutes. Use only for HOW MANY / COUNT questions, NOT for listing which devices are online.
queries.sql: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(IsActive), 0) AS ActiveDeviceCount, COUNT(*) AS TotalDeviceCount FROM (SELECT d.DeviceId, CASE WHEN MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -15, GETDATE()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsActive FROM DMN_Devices d JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID WHERE d.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsEnable, 1) = 1 GROUP BY d.DeviceId) AS t

queries.description: List all devices that are currently online/active — devices where the latest ParameterReadingUpdateTime in DMN_Parameters is within 15 minutes. Shows DeviceName and StationName. Use when user asks WHICH devices are online/active, not just how many.
patterns: which devices are online right now
which devices are active right now
queries.sql: SELECT d.DeviceName, s.StationName, MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) AS LastActive FROM DMN_Devices d JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID WHERE d.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsEnable, 1) = 1 GROUP BY d.DeviceName, s.StationName HAVING MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -15, GETDATE()) ORDER BY d.DeviceName

queries.description: List all devices that are currently offline — devices where the latest ParameterReadingUpdateTime in DMN_Parameters is older than 15 minutes. Shows DeviceName, StationName, and LastActive time.
queries.sql: SELECT d.DeviceName, s.StationName, MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) AS LastActive FROM DMN_Devices d JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID WHERE d.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(d.IsEnable, 1) = 1 GROUP BY d.DeviceName, s.StationName HAVING MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) < DATEADD(MINUTE, -15, GETDATE()) ORDER BY MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) ASC

queries.description: Get the latest readings for a specific device by device name (e.g. BA0010, BA0012, SEI100M0010, SEI100M0114). Use when user mentions a device name matching pattern like BAXXXX or SEI100MXXXX (no space), or uses words like 'device', 'sensor', 'reading for device'.
patterns: what is the aqi for device

queries.description: Check whether a specific device is currently active or inactive based on its last reading timestamp from DMN_Parameters. Active = last reading within 15 minutes. Inactive = last reading 24 hours or older. Warning = between 15 minutes and 24 hours. Use when user asks if a device is active, online, working, sending data, or inactive.
patterns: device active or inactive right now
when did device last send data
when was last data received from device
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 1 d.DeviceName, MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) AS LastMeasured, CASE WHEN MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -15, GETDATE()) THEN 'Active' WHEN MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) <= DATEADD(HOUR, -24, GETDATE()) THEN 'Inactive' ELSE 'Warning' END AS Status FROM DMN_Devices d JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId WHERE d.DeviceName = @deviceName OR REPLACE(LOWER(d.DeviceName),' ','') = REPLACE(LOWER(@deviceName),' ','') GROUP BY d.DeviceName

queries.description: Get current average AQI per region (Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Al Dhafra) from live DMN_Parameters readings. Use for any question about AQI in a region or all regions.
patterns: what is the aqi in abu dhabi
what is the aqi in abudhabi
what is the aqi for abu dhabi
what is the aqi for abudhabi
what is the aqi in al ain
what is the aqi in alain
what is the aqi for al ain
what is the aqi for alain
what is the aqi in al dhafra
what is the aqi in aldhafra
what is the aqi for al dhafra
what is the aqi for aldhafra
air quality for abu dhabi region
air quality for al ain region
air quality for al dhafra region
queries.sql: SELECT r.RegionName, ROUND(AVG(CAST(p.ParameterValue AS FLOAT)), 0) AS AQI, MAX(p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime) AS LastUpdated FROM DMN_Parameters p JOIN DMN_Devices d ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND p.ParameterReadingUpdateTime >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -30, GETDATE()) GROUP BY r.RegionName ORDER BY r.RegionName

queries.description: List sites that have mold test enabled
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, s.OrganizationName, sec.SectorName, r.RegionName FROM DMN_Stations s LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE s.moldtest = 1 AND s.Status = 1 ORDER BY s.StationName
